mn65:2.3: Etha tumhe pi bhikkhave ekāsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjatha;
mn65:2.4: ekāsanabhojanaṃ kho bhikkhave tumhe pi bhuñjamānā appābādhatañ-ca sañjanissatha appātaṅkatañ-ca lahuṭṭhānañ-ca balañ-ca phāsuvihārañ-cāti.
mn65:3.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Bhaddāli Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:

mn65:4.5: Atha kho āyasmā Bhaddāli Bhagavatā sikkhāpade paññāpiyamāne bhikkhusaṅghe sikkhaṃ samādiyamāne anussāhaṃ pavedesi.
mn65:4.6: Atha kho āyasmā Bhaddāli sabban-taṃ temāsaṃ na Bhagavato sammukhībhāvaṃ adāsi yathā taṃ satthusāsane sikkhāya aparipūrakārī.
mn65:5.1: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti:
mn65:6.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bhaddāli yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ sammodi,
mn65:6.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Bhaddāliṃ te bhikkhū etad-avocaṃ:
mn65:6.3: Idaṃ kho āvuso Bhaddāli Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karīyati:
mn65:6.5: Iṅgh' āvuso Bhaddāli etaṃ desakaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, mā te pacchā dukkarataraṃ ahosīti.
mn65:7.1: Evam-āvuso ti kho āyasmā Bhaddāli tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bhaddāli Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn65:7.2: Accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathā bālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ, yo 'haṃ Bhagavatā sikkhāpade paññāpiyamāne bhikkhusaṅghe sikkhaṃ samādiyamāne anussāhaṃ pavedesiṃ.
mn65:7.3: Tassa me bhante Bhagavā accayaṃ accayato patigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti. --

mn65:14.1: Idha Bhaddāli ekacco bhikkhu satthusāsane aparipūrakārī hoti;

mn65:28.6: sace mayaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ pavayha pavayha kāranaṃ karissāma,
mn65:28.7: mā yaṃ pi 'ssa taṃ saddhāmattakaṃ pemamattakaṃ tamhā pi parihāyīti.
mn65:28.8: Ayaṃ kho Bhaddāli hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena-m-idh' ekaccaṃ bhikkhuṃ pavayha pavayha kāraṇaṃ karonti;
mn65:28.9: ayaṃ pana Bhaddāli hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena-m idh' ekaccaṃ bhikkhuṃ no tathā pavayha pavayha kāraṇaṃ karontīti.
mn65:29.1: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena pubbe appatarāni c' eva sikkhāpadāni ahesuṃ bahutarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahiṃsu; \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn65:29.2: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yen' etarahi bahutarāni c' eva sikkhāpadāni honti appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahantīti. --
mn65:30.1: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Bhaddāli hoti: sattesu hāyamānesu saddhamme antaradhāyamāne bahutarāni c' eva sikkhāpadāni honti appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahanti.
mn65:30.2: Na tāva Bhaddāli satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti yāva na idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti.
mn65:30.3: Yato ca kho Bhaddāli idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti tesaṃ yeva āsavaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
mn65:31.1: Na tāva Bhaddāli idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṅgho mahattaṃ patto hoti.
mn65:31.2: Yato ca kho Bhaddāli saṅgho mahattaṃ patto hoti atha idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti,
mn65:31.3: atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti tesaṃ yeva āsavaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
mn65:31.4: Na tāva Bhaddāli idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṅgho lābhaggaṃ patto hoti --pe-- yasaggaṃ patto hoti -- bāhusaccaṃ patto hoti -- rattaññūtaṃ patto hoti.
mn65:31.5: Yato ca kho Bhaddāli saṅgho rattaññūtaṃ patto hoti atha idh' ekacce āsavaṭṭhāniyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti tesaṃ yeva āsavaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
mn65:32.1: Appakā kho tumhe Bhaddāli tena samayena ahuvattha yadā vo ahaṃ ājānīyasusūpamaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ desesiṃ;
mn65:32.5: So hi nūnāhaṃ bhante dīgharattaṃ satthusāsane sikkhāya aparipūrakārī ahosin-ti. --
mn65:32.6: Na kho Bhaddāli es' eva hetu esa paccayo;
mn65:32.7: api ca me tvaṃ Bhaddāli dīgharattaṃ cetasā ceto paricca vidito:
mn65:32.8: na vāyaṃ moghapuriso mayā dhamme desiyamāne aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇātīti.
mn65:32.9: Api ca te ahaṃ Bhaddāli ājānīyasusūpamaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ desissāmi,
mn65:32.10: taṃ suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ bhāsissāmīti.
mn65:32.11: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Bhaddāli Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn65:33.1: Seyyathā pi Bhaddāli dakkho assadamako bhadraṃ assājānīyaṃ labhitvā paṭhamen' eva mukhādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāreti,
mn65:33.2: tassa mukhādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa honti yeva visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici yathā taṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa,
mn65:33.3: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati.
mn65:33.4: Yato kho Bhaddāli bhadro assājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam-enaṃ assadamako uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti yugādhāne,
mn65:33.5: tassa yugādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa honti yeva visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici yathā taṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa,
mn65:33.6: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati.
mn65:33.7: Yato kho Bhaddāli bhadro assājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tamenaṃ assadamako uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāye dhāve ravatthe rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye,
mn65:33.8: tassa uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa honti yeva visūkāyitāni visevitānī vipphanditāni kānici kānici yathā taṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa,
mn65:33.9: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati.
mn65:33.10: Yato ca kho Bhaddāli bhadro assājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam-enaṃ assadamako uttariṃ vaṇṇiyañ-ca valiyañ-ca anuppavecchati.
mn65:33.11: Imehi kho Bhaddāli dasah' aṅgehi samannāgato bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgan-t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn65:34.1: Evam-eva kho Bhaddāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyye añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa;
mn65:34.3: Idha Bhaddāli bhikkhu asekhāya sammādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāsaṅkhappena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāvācāya samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammākammantena samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāājīvena samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāvāyāmena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāsatiyā samannāgato hoti, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ asekhena sammāsamādhinā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāñāṇena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāvimuttiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn65:34.4: Imehi kho Bhaddāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
mn65:34.6: Attamano āyasmā Bhaddāli Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 66.
